title: The ‘forum effect’: how does participation in online forums affect student retention and academic performance at a distance learning university?
reason: Per-student forum-post counts, replies, initiated posts and word counts from the VLE enter logit models predicting retention and pass/distinction/fail outcomes, controlling for prior attainment and demographics.

extraction.design: correlational (binary and multinomial logistic regression) + interviews (mixed methods)
extraction.n_quote: collated cross-sectional demographic, academic and forum activity indicators for the students on the Economics course in 2021 (n=748) and 2022 (n=665), a total of 1413 observations for the regression analysis, carried out using Stata software.
extraction.population: undergraduate introductory Economics distance-learning students, The Open University (2 cohorts)
extraction.lms_indicators: number of tutor-group forum posts; replies; total posts in all forums; total word count; any initiated post (dummy)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: module retention (binary); final result fail-resit / pass / distinction (multinomial)

effect_sizes.between: one additional forum post ↔ odds of retention
effect_sizes.quote: the odds 1 PiPi of retaining that student relative to not retaining them increases by e0:328 , equal to a factor of 1.388.

effect_sizes.value: TGF 0.221***, reply 0.0960*, all forums 0.148*** (distinction vs pass); fail-resit −1.064, −0.722, −0.356 n.s.
effect_sizes.between: forum posts ↔ distinction (vs pass) and fail-resit (vs pass), n=361-582

effect_sizes.value: word count 0.00105***; initiated post 0.833*** (distinction); fail-resit −0.00329, 0.278 n.s.
effect_sizes.between: word count / initiated post ↔ distinction and fail-resit (n=582)

extraction.notes: Analytic n after listwise deletion: 892 (retention, all-forum models), 404/440 (TGF/reply), 361-582 (achievement). Forum effect significant only at the pass/distinction boundary. Coefficients are unstandardised logits; 11 student interviews add qualitative data.
